chaChaanTeng.title: Chapter 2: The Cha Chaan Teng Battle
chaChaanTeng.description: Navigate a high-velocity local diner and place orders like a local.

success.headline: Instant Order Accepted!
success.subtext: The waiter scribbled your order without looking up and shouted it to the kitchen.

warning.headline: The Point-and-Hope
warning.subtext: The waiter paused, tilted their head, then pointed at the menu board to confirm.

danger.headline: Menu Board Pointing
danger.subtext: The waiter sighed and gestured at the laminated English menu.
